about: Level 10 Wilderness north of Edgeville in rune armour with a rune scimitar, 70 melee, 85 Magic, 43 Prayer, 20 sharks and the runes for five Tele Blocks. Two accounts start the same fight; ::wildy n moves to another level.
notes: For the Wilderness's PvP steps and trying a fight by hand: both players run it, then ::seed n before the first attack to repeat the rolls. The loadout is ours. Combat level 85 with these stats, so any level that allows an attack between two of them does.
